children: Here's a list of key deals reported across sectors this week:
Service Properties Trust
was surging after the hospitality investment firm TKO LLC proposed to acquire the former's entire hospitality portfolio for $2.0B.
Viatris
and Pacira BioSciences
said they entered into a definitive agreement under which Viatris will acquire all outstanding shares of Pacira for $36.50 per share in cash, representing an aggregate equity value of $1.65B.
Option Care Health
shares jumped 34% in early trading on Tuesday after CD&R and McKesson
announced a definitive agreement to acquire the company for $32.05 per share, valuing it at approximately $5.8 billion including debt.
Energy Transfer
said Tuesday it agreed to
Vaquero Midstream in a $2.625B deal consisting of $1.95B in cash and ~33.3M newly issued Energy Transfer common units.
Canadian utility ​companies Emera
and Canadian Utilities
said Tuesday they agreed to a ​

in an all-stock transaction worth C$14.3B (US$10B), creating ​a combined company with a C$72B enterprise value and a regulated rate base of C$45B serving ~6M customers across Canada, the U.S., and international markets.
Cenovus Energy
said Monday it agreed to
Athabasca Oil
in a cash-and-stock deal valued at ~C$5.7B, representing a 14% premium to Athabasca's 20-day volume-weighted average trading price.
Schneider Electric SE
said it has agreed to acquire U.S.-based engineering software developer PTC Inc.
for $22.6 billion (€20.1 billion). The French conglomerate will buy PTC for $205 per share in an all-cash deal, it said in a statement.
CCC Intelligent Solutions
soared 13% in after-hours trading on a report that private equity firm GTCR and Elliott Investment Management are in advanced discussions to purchase the car-insurance software firm.
